name: Matter-Server
description: Matter controller server (matter.js) for Home Assistant. Successor of the Python Matter Server. Requires host networking and IPv6 on the host interface.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Matter fabric data (node credentials, certificates). Must be owned by UID/GID 1000. Back this up!

variables.name: Primary Interface
variables.description: Host network interface used for mDNS/Matter (e.g. br0, eth0). Must have IPv6 enabled.

variables.name: Listen Address
variables.description: Bind address(es) for the WebSocket API/dashboard on port 5580. Empty = all interfaces. Use 127.0.0.1 if Home Assistant runs on the same host with host networking (dashboard is then only reachable locally).

variables.name: Port
variables.description: WebSocket API and dashboard port. Home Assistant connects to ws://<host>:5580/ws

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: critical, error, warning, info, debug, verbose

variables.name: Time Sync
variables.description: Automatically sync time to Matter devices that support it.
